In rollout 3 (C5 passed), the commitment says "Rosa to release the rapid metabolic genetics panel kit for the 11:00 courier pickup tomorrow" — again both kit and courier. The check appears to require a single commitment (or commitment detail) that jointly names both the collection kit and the reserved courier, and the failing rollouts split or omit one element.

C6 (PF2) failed in rollout 2: ENCODING MISMATCH. PF2 was revealed by A3 at turn 9 ("Patient B's family has already accepted an appointment with Northside Genetics for Friday at 15:00") and cited in justification_fact_ids. In rollout 3 (C6 passed), there was a "referral_record_update" commitment with detail "Patient B's Northside Genetics appointment (Friday 15:00, confirmed by family) formally recorded in referral plan." In rollout 1 (C6 passed), there was a "referral_disposition" commitment with detail "Patient B has accepted an outside appointment at Northside Genetics on Friday at 15:00." In rollout 2, the settlement has only three commitments, all about Patient A (authorization_attachment, specimen_collection_plan_entry, kit_release) — none about Patient B.
